events.title: Woodstock Festival's 57th Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, becoming a defining moment of the counterculture generation.

angles.name: Woodstock Reflection
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the Woodstock Festival kicked off. What's your favourite memory or track from the iconic event?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's Death
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering The King, Elvis Presley, who we lost on this day in 1977. What's the one Elvis track that always gets you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! What's your favourite Pretenders track or a song that showcases her incredible voice?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher turns 54 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid is 54 today! Happy Birthday to Liam Gallagher. What's your top Oasis anthem or a solo track from the man himself?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007 today. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. What's your most cherished Lennon or Beatles track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Death
events.blurb: We remember Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?
